title: Nvidia announces native GPU programming in Rust

paragraphs.en: In September 2026, NVIDIA announced it is leaning into native GPU programming in Rust. CUDA C++ and CUDA Python are mature, enterprise-grade toolchains, and NVIDIA will be growing and maturing CUDA Rust into 2027 and beyond
paragraphs.zh: 2026年9月，NVIDIA宣布将大力投入Rust原生的GPU编程。 CUDA C++和CUDA Python是成熟的企业级工具链，NVIDIA将在2027年及以后持续发展并完善CUDA Rust。

sents.en: In September 2026, NVIDIA announced it is leaning into native GPU programming in Rust.
sents.zh: 2026年9月，NVIDIA宣布将大力投入Rust原生的GPU编程。

sents.en: CUDA C++ and CUDA Python are mature, enterprise-grade toolchains, and NVIDIA will be growing and maturing CUDA Rust into 2027 and beyond
sents.zh: CUDA C++和CUDA Python是成熟的企业级工具链，NVIDIA将在2027年及以后持续发展并完善CUDA Rust。

paragraphs.en: The systems layer of AI spans inference engines, serving infrastructure, drivers, and agent runtimes, and it churns constantly as models and techniques change. More and more of it is written in Rust, which catches whole classes of bugs at compile time without giving up performance.
paragraphs.zh: AI 的系统层涵盖推理引擎、服务基础设施、驱动程序和智能体运行时，并且随着模型和技术的变化而不断变动。 其中越来越多的部分用 Rust 编写，Rust 能在编译期捕获整类缺陷，同时不牺牲性能。

sents.en: The systems layer of AI spans inference engines, serving infrastructure, drivers, and agent runtimes, and it churns constantly as models and techniques change.
sents.zh: AI 的系统层涵盖推理引擎、服务基础设施、驱动程序和智能体运行时，并且随着模型和技术的变化而不断变动。

sents.en: More and more of it is written in Rust, which catches whole classes of bugs at compile time without giving up performance.
sents.zh: 其中越来越多的部分用 Rust 编写，Rust 能在编译期捕获整类缺陷，同时不牺牲性能。

paragraphs.en: NVIDIA is part of that shift for the same reason. The Nova Linux driver is written in Rust. NVIDIA Dynamo is built on a Rust core. NVTX has Rust bindings.
paragraphs.zh: 英伟达出于同样的原因也是这一转变的一部分。 Nova Linux 驱动程序是用 Rust 编写的。 NVIDIA Dynamo 构建在 Rust 核心之上。NVTX 拥有 Rust 绑定。

sents.en: NVIDIA is part of that shift for the same reason.
sents.zh: 英伟达出于同样的原因也是这一转变的一部分。

sents.en: The Nova Linux driver is written in Rust.
sents.zh: Nova Linux 驱动程序是用 Rust 编写的。

sents.en: NVIDIA Dynamo is built on a Rust core. NVTX has Rust bindings.
sents.zh: NVIDIA Dynamo 构建在 Rust 核心之上。NVTX 拥有 Rust 绑定。

paragraphs.en: The GPU kernel is the exception. You can launch kernels from Rust, but the kernel itself often has to be written in another language.
paragraphs.zh: GPU 内核是个例外。 你可以从 Rust 启动内核，但内核本身通常必须用另一种语言编写。

sents.en: The GPU kernel is the exception.
sents.zh: GPU 内核是个例外。

sents.en: You can launch kernels from Rust, but the kernel itself often has to be written in another language.
sents.zh: 你可以从 Rust 启动内核，但内核本身通常必须用另一种语言编写。

paragraphs.en: NVIDIA CUDA Rust closes that gap. GPU kernels can be written in Rust, compiled natively to PTX, rather than a wrapper around code from somewhere else.
paragraphs.zh: NVIDIA CUDA Rust 弥补了这一差距。 GPU 内核可以用 Rust 编写，并原生编译为 PTX，而不是对来自其他地方的代码的封装。

sents.en: NVIDIA CUDA Rust closes that gap.
sents.zh: NVIDIA CUDA Rust 弥补了这一差距。

sents.en: GPU kernels can be written in Rust, compiled natively to PTX, rather than a wrapper around code from somewhere else.
sents.zh: GPU 内核可以用 Rust 编写，并原生编译为 PTX，而不是对来自其他地方的代码的封装。

paragraphs.en: There are two tracks to use Rust, matching the two tracks CUDA itself has. SIMT is the model you already write in CUDA C++ or numba-cuda . You indicate what one thread does, and launch thousands of them. Tile is a newer programming model, which is also available in C++ and Python . All of these frontends let you say what one tile of data does, and the Tile IR compiler does the rest.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 Rust 有两条路线，与 CUDA 自身拥有的两条路线相对应。 SIMT 就是你在 CUDA C++ 或 numba-cuda 中已经在编写的模型。 你只需说明一个线程做什么，然后启动成千上万个线程。 Tile 是一种较新的编程模型，在 C++ 和 Python 中也可使用。 所有这些前端都让你描述一个数据分块做什么，剩下的由 Tile IR 编译器完成。

sents.zh: 使用 Rust 有两条路线，与 CUDA 自身拥有的两条路线相对应。

sents.en: SIMT is the model you already write in CUDA C++ or numba-cuda .
sents.zh: SIMT 就是你在 CUDA C++ 或 numba-cuda 中已经在编写的模型。

sents.en: You indicate what one thread does, and launch thousands of them.
sents.zh: 你只需说明一个线程做什么，然后启动成千上万个线程。

sents.zh: Tile 是一种较新的编程模型，在 C++ 和 Python 中也可使用。

sents.zh: 所有这些前端都让你描述一个数据分块做什么，剩下的由 Tile IR 编译器完成。

paragraphs.en: When you are picking one to build on, reach for Tile first. The compiler decides how tiles map onto each architecture, so your source doesn’t encode architecture-specific choices, and you drop to SIMT when you need that control or want to manage memory and threads yourself.
paragraphs.zh: 当你在挑选要在此基础上构建的东西时，请优先选择 Tile。 编译器决定 Tile 如何映射到每种架构，因此你的源代码不需要编码特定于架构的选择；当你需要那种控制权，或想要自己管理内存和线程时，再退回到 SIMT。

paragraphs.en: Which language you reach for is a separate question from which model. Use the CUDA exposure that best fits the stack you already have. The two projects below are for when that stack is Rust. We plan to support inter-language interop, so the choice does not lock you out of the others.
paragraphs.zh: 选择哪种语言与选择哪个模型是两个独立的问题。 请使用最契合你现有技术栈的 CUDA 方案。 下面两个项目适用于你的技术栈是 Rust 的情况。 我们计划支持跨语言互操作，因此这一选择不会让你无法使用其他语言。

paragraphs.en: Below is the same kernel on each track, which performs elementwise addition over 1,024 floats. Both are complete programs, both run, and both print the same line, so you can read them side by side and see what changes.
paragraphs.zh: 下面是每条路径上相同的内核，它对 1,024 个浮点数执行逐元素加法。 两者都是完整的程序，都能运行，并且都会打印相同的一行，因此你可以并排阅读它们，看看有什么变化。

paragraphs.en: cuda-oxide is a custom rustc codegen backend. It intercepts compilation, routes #[kernel] functions through Rust MIR, the community Pliron IR framework, and LLVM IR down to PTX, and hands everything else to the standard backend. The GPU dialects on top of Pliron are ours. The dialects and every transform stay in Rust until the standard LLVM backend takes over.
paragraphs.zh: cuda-oxide 是一个自定义的 rustc 代码生成后端。 它会拦截编译过程，将 #[kernel] 函数经由 Rust MIR、社区 Pliron IR 框架和 LLVM IR 一路传递到 PTX，而把其余所有内容交给标准后端。 Pliron 之上的 GPU 方言由我们编写。 在标准 LLVM 后端接管之前，这些方言和所有变换都保留在 Rust 中。

paragraphs.zh: 它会打印 PASSED: all 1024 elements correct（通过：全部 1024 个元素正确）。 这就是完成该任务的整个程序，正是 cargo oxide new 所写出的内容，此处添加了注释：

sents.en: It prints PASSED: all 1024 elements correct .
sents.zh: 它会打印 PASSED: all 1024 elements correct（通过：全部 1024 个元素正确）。

sents.en: This is the whole program that did it, exactly what cargo oxide new wrote, with comments added here:
sents.zh: 这就是完成该任务的整个程序，正是 cargo oxide new 所写出的内容，此处添加了注释：

paragraphs.en: use cuda_device::{kernel, launch_bounds, launch_contract, thread, DisjointSlice}; use cuda_host::cuda_module; use cuda_core::{CudaContext, DeviceBuffer, LaunchConfig1D}; // === DEVICE CODE - everything in here is compiled to PTX === // The macro also generates the host-side API used further down: // `load`, `prepare_vecadd`, and the safe `vecadd` launch method. #[cuda_module] mod kernels { use super::*; #[kernel] // GPU entry point #[launch_bounds(256)] // max threads per block; lets the compiler budget registers #[launch_contract(domain = 1, block = (256, 1, 1))] // indexes in 1-D, 256-thread blocks pub fn vecadd(a: &[f32], b: &[f32], mut c: DisjointSlice<f32>) { let idx = thread::index_1d(); let idx_raw = idx.get(); // the plain usize, for reading the inputs if let Some(c_elem) = c.get_mut(idx) { *c_elem = a[idx_raw] + b[idx_raw]; } } } fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> { // === HOST SETUP - device, stream, and buffers === let ctx = CudaContext::new(0)?; let stream = ctx.default_stream(); const N: usize = 1024; let a_host: Vec<f32> = (0..N).map(|i| i as f32).collect(); let b_host: Vec<f32> = (0..N).map(|i| (i * 2) as f32).collect(); let a_dev = DeviceBuffer::from_host(&stream, &a_host)?; let b_dev = DeviceBuffer::from_host(&stream, &b_host)?; let mut c_dev = DeviceBuffer::<f32>::zeroed(&stream, N)?; // === LOAD, PREPARE, LAUNCH === // SAFETY: this package owns the embedded device bundle produced for the // kernels module above. let module = unsafe { kernels::load(&ctx)? }; // 4 blocks of 256 threads, 0 bytes of dynamic shared memory. `prepare_vecadd` // checks that against the contract above and against the live device limits. // The safe `vecadd` below takes that token where a raw config would go. let prepared = module.prepare_vecadd(LaunchConfig1D::new((N as u32).div_ceil(256), 256, 0))?; module.vecadd(&stream, &prepared, &a_dev, &b_dev, &mut c_dev)?; // === READ BACK AND VERIFY === // Copies down and synchronizes, so the launch has finished by the time // `c_host` can be read. let c_host = c_dev.to_host_vec(&stream)?; let errors = (0..N) .filter(|&i| (c_host[i] - (a_host[i] + b_host[i])).abs() > 1e-5) .count(); if errors == 0 { println!("PASSED: all {} elements correct", N); } else { eprintln!("FAILED: {} errors", errors); std::process::exit(1); } Ok(()) } Host and device code live in one file, build with one command, and need no separate kernel crate.

Read the kernel signature first, because it carries the whole safety argument. a and b are ordinary shared slices, readable by every thread. c is a DisjointSlice<f32> , a type that hands each thread exclusive access to its own element and nothing else. It exists because &mut [f32] is the wrong shape for the job. Every thread would need the same &mut , which Rust correctly refuses. DisjointSlice splits that one mutable borrow into per-thread pieces.
paragraphs.zh: 先读内核签名，因为它承载了整个安全性论证。a 和 b 是普通的共享切片，每个线程都可读。c 是 DisjointSlice<f32>，这种类型让每个线程独占访问自己的元素，且仅此而已。 它之所以存在，是因为 &mut [f32] 的形状不适合这个任务。 每个线程都需要同一个 &mut，而 Rust 正确地拒绝了这一点。 DisjointSlice 将那一次可变借用拆分成每个线程各自的一份。

sents.en: DisjointSlice splits that one mutable borrow into per-thread pieces.
sents.zh: DisjointSlice 将那一次可变借用拆分成每个线程各自的一份。

paragraphs.en: thread::index_1d() returns an index type, not a bare integer, and c.get_mut(idx) only accepts that type. You get back an Option , so the out-of-bounds case is a branch you handle rather than a memory error you find later.
paragraphs.zh: thread::index_1d() 返回的是一个索引类型，而不是裸整数，并且 c.get_mut(idx) 只接受该类型。 你得到的是一个 Option，因此越界情况是你需要处理的一个分支，而不是之后才发现的内存错误。

paragraphs.en: The launch is checked rather than trusted. #[launch_contract] declares that this kernel indexes in one dimension with 256-thread blocks. prepare_vecadd validates your LaunchConfig1D against that declaration and the live device limits, and hands back a proof that the safe vecadd method requires. Kernels without a contract expose only raw unsafe launch methods, because a bare LaunchConfig says nothing about the kernel it is launching.
paragraphs.zh: 启动是经过检查而非信任的。#[launch_contract] 声明该内核以一维索引、256 线程的块进行。prepare_vecadd 会根据该声明以及实际设备限制来验证你的 LaunchConfig1D，并返回安全的 vecadd 方法所需的证明。 没有契约的内核只暴露原始的不安全启动方法，因为一个裸的 LaunchConfig 对它所启动的内核没有任何说明。

paragraphs.en: cutile-rs works one level higher. You perform computations on tiles rather than scalars. Each tile block runs the kernel body once as a single logical thread over one sub-tensor of data, and the compiler decides how many real GPU threads back it. The #[cutile::module] macro embeds the kernel’s AST in the host binary and JIT-compiles it through CUDA Tile IR (the NVIDIA tile-level compiler IR) when the kernel is first needed.
paragraphs.zh: cutile-rs 在更高一层工作。 你对瓦片（tile）而非标量执行计算。 每个瓦片块以单一逻辑线程的形式对数据的一个子张量运行一次内核体，由编译器决定由多少真实 GPU 线程来支撑它。 #[cutile::module] 宏将内核的 AST 嵌入宿主二进制文件中，并在首次需要该内核时通过 CUDA Tile IR（NVIDIA 的瓦片级编译器 IR）进行 JIT 编译。

sents.en: cutile-rs works one level higher.
sents.zh: cutile-rs 在更高一层工作。

sents.en: You perform computations on tiles rather than scalars.
sents.zh: 你对瓦片（tile）而非标量执行计算。

sents.en: Each tile block runs the kernel body once as a single logical thread over one sub-tensor of data, and the compiler decides how many real GPU threads back it.
sents.zh: 每个瓦片块以单一逻辑线程的形式对数据的一个子张量运行一次内核体，由编译器决定由多少真实 GPU 线程来支撑它。

sents.en: The #[cutile::module] macro embeds the kernel’s AST in the host binary and JIT-compiles it through CUDA Tile IR (the NVIDIA tile-level compiler IR) when the kernel is first needed.
sents.zh: #[cutile::module] 宏将内核的 AST 嵌入宿主二进制文件中，并在首次需要该内核时通过 CUDA Tile IR（NVIDIA 的瓦片级编译器 IR）进行 JIT 编译。

paragraphs.en: Requirements are lighter than the SIMT track. You need a GPU with compute capability 8.0 or later, CUDA 13.3, stable Rust 1.89 or newer, and Linux, but no nightly toolchain and no LLVM of your own.

paragraphs.en: cargo new vecadd_demo cd vecadd_demo cargo add cutile Here is the same elementwise addition, written for tiles. Paste it into src/main.rs and cargo run :
paragraphs.zh: cargo new vecadd_demo cd vecadd_demo cargo add cutile 下面是同样的逐元素加法，这次是针对分片（tile）编写的。 将其粘贴到 src/main.rs 中并运行 cargo run：

sents.en: cargo new vecadd_demo cd vecadd_demo cargo add cutile Here is the same elementwise addition, written for tiles.

sents.en: Paste it into src/main.rs and cargo run :
sents.zh: 将其粘贴到 src/main.rs 中并运行 cargo run：

paragraphs.en: use cutile::prelude::*; // The macro captures this module's AST into the host binary. The kernel is // JIT-compiled through CUDA Tile IR the first time it is actually launched. #[cutile::module] mod kernel { use cutile::core::*; #[cutile::entry()] fn add<const B: i32>( // B is the tile width, a static dimension. A different B produces a // different specialization. z: &mut Tensor<f32, { [B] }>, // exclusive output, one sub-tensor of B elements x: &Tensor<f32, { [-1] }>, // shared input; -1 is a dynamic dimension, resolved at launch y: &Tensor<f32, { [-1] }>, ) { // This body runs once per mut sub-tensor, as a single logical thread. // Tile kernels load tiles, not scalars, from x and y. let tx = load_tile_like(x, z); // the slice of x lining up with this sub-tensor of z let ty = load_tile_like(y, z); z.store(tx + ty); // elementwise across the whole tile } } fn main() -> Result<(), Error> { let device = Device::new(0)?; let stream = device.new_stream()?; // These are lazy. Nothing has touched the GPU yet. let x = api::ones::<f32>(&[1024]); let y = api::ones::<f32>(&[1024]); // Partitioning does three things at once: gives each tile exclusive // ownership of its own 128-element chunk, fixes the grid at 1024/128 = 8 // tiles, and supplies B. let z = api::zeros::<f32>(&[1024]).partition([128]); let c: Vec<f32> = kernel::add(z, x, y) // takes ownership of all three tensors .first() // ...and returns them; pick the output back out .unpartition() // drop the host-side partition wrapper; no data moves .to_host_vec() // record the copy back .sync_on(&stream)?; // and only now does any of it run let errors = c.iter().filter(|&&v| (v - 2.0).abs() > 1e-5).count(); if errors == 0 { println!("PASSED: all {} elements correct", c.len()); } else { eprintln!("FAILED: {errors} errors"); } Ok(()) } PASSED: all 1024 elements correct

paragraphs.en: The Tile track reaches the same answer on stable Rust, and its signature makes the same safety argument. There is no DisjointSlice this time. Partitioning on the host is only needed for mutable tensors, and it hands each tile block one writable sub-tensor that no other tile block can overlap. That exclusivity is what &mut already guarantees.
paragraphs.zh: Tile 轨道在稳定版 Rust 上也能得到相同答案，且其签名给出同样的安全性论证。 这次不存在 DisjointSlice。 在主机端做划分只在可变张量时才需要，它交给每个 tile 块一个可写子张量，其他 tile 块都无法与其重叠。 这种排他性正是 &mut 已经保证的。

sents.en: The Tile track reaches the same answer on stable Rust, and its signature makes the same safety argument.
sents.zh: Tile 轨道在稳定版 Rust 上也能得到相同答案，且其签名给出同样的安全性论证。

sents.en: There is no DisjointSlice this time.
sents.zh: 这次不存在 DisjointSlice。

sents.en: Partitioning on the host is only needed for mutable tensors, and it hands each tile block one writable sub-tensor that no other tile block can overlap.
sents.zh: 在主机端做划分只在可变张量时才需要，它交给每个 tile 块一个可写子张量，其他 tile 块都无法与其重叠。

sents.en: That exclusivity is what &mut already guarantees.
sents.zh: 这种排他性正是 &mut 已经保证的。

paragraphs.en: The -1 in the input shapes is a sentinel rather than a size. That dimension is read off the tensor at launch, so the shape can vary without recompiling.
paragraphs.zh: 输入形状中的 -1 是一个哨兵值，而不是尺寸。 该维度在启动时从张量中读取，因此形状可以变化而无需重新编译。

sents.en: The -1 in the input shapes is a sentinel rather than a size.
sents.zh: 输入形状中的 -1 是一个哨兵值，而不是尺寸。

sents.en: That dimension is read off the tensor at launch, so the shape can vary without recompiling.
sents.zh: 该维度在启动时从张量中读取，因此形状可以变化而无需重新编译。

paragraphs.en: The interesting line on the host is .partition([128]) , and it is doing three jobs at once. It makes the exclusivity real. Each tile owns its 128-element chunk and no other tile can touch it. It fixes the launch geometry, since 1,024 divided by 128 is a grid of 8 tiles.
paragraphs.zh: 主机上有趣的一行是 .partition([128])，它同时完成了三件事。 它让排他性成为现实。 每个分块拥有自己的 128 元素片段，其他分块无法触碰它。 它确定了启动几何结构，因为 1,024 除以 128 正好是一个由 8 个分块组成的网格。

sents.en: The interesting line on the host is .partition([128]) , and it is doing three jobs at once.
sents.zh: 主机上有趣的一行是 .partition([128])，它同时完成了三件事。

sents.en: It makes the exclusivity real.
sents.zh: 它让排他性成为现实。

sents.en: Each tile owns its 128-element chunk and no other tile can touch it.
sents.zh: 每个分块拥有自己的 128 元素片段，其他分块无法触碰它。

sents.en: It fixes the launch geometry, since 1,024 divided by 128 is a grid of 8 tiles.
sents.zh: 它确定了启动几何结构，因为 1,024 除以 128 正好是一个由 8 个分块组成的网格。

paragraphs.en: The grid follows from the partition instead of being computed separately and checked against the kernel’s indexing. It also supplies B , which is never written at the call site because the launcher reads the tile width off the partition. That is why a &mut output has to be partitioned before it can be passed at all.
paragraphs.zh: 网格由分区推导得出，而不是单独计算后再对照内核的索引进行检查。 它还提供 B，由于启动器从分区中读取分块宽度，调用点从不需要写出 B。 这就是为什么 &mut output 必须先经过分区才能被传入。

sents.en: The grid follows from the partition instead of being computed separately and checked against the kernel’s indexing.
sents.zh: 网格由分区推导得出，而不是单独计算后再对照内核的索引进行检查。

sents.en: It also supplies B , which is never written at the call site because the launcher reads the tile width off the partition.
sents.zh: 它还提供 B，由于启动器从分区中读取分块宽度，调用点从不需要写出 B。

sents.en: That is why a &mut output has to be partitioned before it can be passed at all.
sents.zh: 这就是为什么 &mut output 必须先经过分区才能被传入。

paragraphs.en: Then look at what the launch returns. The add you call on the host is a macro-generated launcher, not the device function above. It takes ownership of all three tensors and hands them back as a tuple when the GPU is done. That is what .first() is for, picking the output back out of it.
paragraphs.zh: 然后看看这次启动返回了什么。 你在主机上调用的 add 是一个由宏生成的启动器，而不是上面的设备函数。 它接管全部三个张量的所有权，并在 GPU 完成后把它们作为一个元组交还回来。 这就是 .first() 的用途——从元组中把输出取回来。

sents.en: Then look at what the launch returns.
sents.zh: 然后看看这次启动返回了什么。

sents.en: The add you call on the host is a macro-generated launcher, not the device function above.
sents.zh: 你在主机上调用的 add 是一个由宏生成的启动器，而不是上面的设备函数。

sents.en: It takes ownership of all three tensors and hands them back as a tuple when the GPU is done.
sents.zh: 它接管全部三个张量的所有权，并在 GPU 完成后把它们作为一个元组交还回来。

sents.en: That is what .first() is for, picking the output back out of it.
sents.zh: 这就是 .first() 的用途——从元组中把输出取回来。

paragraphs.en: Nothing runs until .sync_on(&stream) . Everything before it is a lazy description, recorded rather than submitted. That includes the ones , the zeros , the kernel call, and even the copy back to the host. The whole program is one chain with a single synchronization point.
paragraphs.zh: 在调用 .sync_on(&stream) 之前，什么都不会运行。 在此之前的一切都是惰性描述，只是被记录下来，而非被提交。 这包括那些一、那些零、内核调用，甚至拷贝回主机的操作。 整个程序就是一条只有一个同步点的链。

sents.en: Nothing runs until .sync_on(&stream) .
sents.zh: 在调用 .sync_on(&stream) 之前，什么都不会运行。

sents.en: Everything before it is a lazy description, recorded rather than submitted.
sents.zh: 在此之前的一切都是惰性描述，只是被记录下来，而非被提交。

sents.en: That includes the ones , the zeros , the kernel call, and even the copy back to the host.
sents.zh: 这包括那些一、那些零、内核调用，甚至拷贝回主机的操作。

sents.en: The whole program is one chain with a single synchronization point.
sents.zh: 整个程序就是一条只有一个同步点的链。

paragraphs.en: Both kernels make the same claim about memory. Their inputs are shared, and their output belongs to one writer alone. They differ only in the level at which they make it, and in whether a purpose-built type is needed to make it at all.
paragraphs.zh: 两个内核都对内存做出了相同的声明。 它们的输入是共享的，而它们的输出只属于一个写入者。 它们的区别仅在于做出声明的层级不同，以及是否需要专门构建的类型来做出这一声明。

sents.en: Both kernels make the same claim about memory.
sents.zh: 两个内核都对内存做出了相同的声明。

sents.en: Their inputs are shared, and their output belongs to one writer alone.
sents.zh: 它们的输入是共享的，而它们的输出只属于一个写入者。

sents.en: They differ only in the level at which they make it, and in whether a purpose-built type is needed to make it at all.
sents.zh: 它们的区别仅在于做出声明的层级不同，以及是否需要专门构建的类型来做出这一声明。

paragraphs.en: That matters because thousands of threads reach the same buffers in no guaranteed order. When two of them hit the same address and one is writing, the ordering decides the result. Those bugs rarely reproduce on demand, and they pass tests before failing in production.
paragraphs.zh: 这一点很重要，因为成千上万个线程会以无法保证的顺序访问相同的缓冲区。 当其中两个线程访问同一地址且其中一个在写入时，访问顺序就决定了结果。 这类缺陷很少能按需复现，它们往往能通过测试，直到进入生产环境后才出故障。

sents.en: That matters because thousands of threads reach the same buffers in no guaranteed order.
sents.zh: 这一点很重要，因为成千上万个线程会以无法保证的顺序访问相同的缓冲区。

sents.en: When two of them hit the same address and one is writing, the ordering decides the result.
sents.zh: 当其中两个线程访问同一地址且其中一个在写入时，访问顺序就决定了结果。

sents.en: Those bugs rarely reproduce on demand, and they pass tests before failing in production.
sents.zh: 这类缺陷很少能按需复现，它们往往能通过测试，直到进入生产环境后才出故障。

paragraphs.en: Passing the SIMT kernel’s output buffer as one of its own inputs does not compile, whether or not that kernel would actually race:
paragraphs.zh: 将 SIMT 内核的输出缓冲区作为其自身输入之一传递时无法通过编译，无论该内核是否真的会发生竞争：

paragraphs.en: module.vecadd(&stream, &prepared, &c_dev, &b_dev, &mut c_dev)?; error[E0502]: cannot borrow `c_dev` as mutable because it is also borrowed as immutable
paragraphs.zh: module.vecadd(&stream, &prepared, &c_dev, &b_dev, &mut c_dev)?; 错误[E0502]：无法将 `c_dev` 以可变方式借用，因为它已经被以不可变方式借用了

paragraphs.en: The same aliasing on the Tile side does not compile either:
paragraphs.zh: Tile 一侧同样的别名问题也无法通过编译：

paragraphs.en: let z = api::zeros::<f32>(&[1024]); kernel::add(z.partition([128]), z, y) error[E0382]: use of moved value: `z`
paragraphs.zh:
```rust
let z = api::zeros::<f32>(&[1024]); kernel::add(z.partition([128]), z, y)
```
错误[E0382]：使用了已被移动的值：`z`

paragraphs.en: Both examples catch the classic aliasing mistake at compile time, and they draw the line in different places. cuda-oxide checks each launch call. cutile-rs’s ownership follows the tensors across the launch boundary, which is the stronger of the two claims.
paragraphs.zh: 两个例子都在编译期捕获了经典的别名错误，但它们划定的界限位置不同。cuda-oxide 在每次启动调用时进行检查。cutile-rs 的所有权机制则跨越启动边界跟随张量，这是两者中更强的保证。

paragraphs.en: Tile gives you no shared memory or thread indexing to get wrong, because the compiler owns both. A tile block is a single logical thread, so there are no threads for you to race. That is what makes it safe by construction, and it is also what you trade away. SIMT keeps that control, and today shared memory there requires unsafe . Shared memory is the bedrock of fast SIMT kernels, so making that path safe is active work.
paragraphs.zh: Tile 不会给你需要写错的共享内存或线程索引，因为这两者都由编译器负责。 一个 tile 块是单个逻辑线程，所以不存在会让你产生竞态的线程。 这正是它在构造上安全的原因，也是你为此付出的代价。 SIMT 保留了这种控制权，如今那里的共享内存需要不安全的 unsafe。 共享内存是快速 SIMT 内核的基石，所以让这条路径变得安全是正在进行的工作。

paragraphs.en: Both projects are early-stage and neither is production-ready. cuda-oxide is early alpha. cutile-rs is further along, published on crates.io and already used outside NVIDIA in HuggingFace’s Grout inference engine and in mistral.rs . Coverage is incomplete and APIs will move. Where you find rough edges, we want to hear about them.
paragraphs.zh: 两个项目都处于早期阶段，均未达到生产可用状态。cuda-oxide 还处于早期 alpha 阶段。cutile-rs 的进展更远一些，已发布在 crates.io 上，并且已在 NVIDIA 之外得到使用，包括 HuggingFace 的 Grout 推理引擎和 mistral.rs。 覆盖范围尚不完整，API 也会变动。 如果你发现了粗糙之处，我们希望听到你的反馈。

sents.en: Both projects are early-stage and neither is production-ready. cuda-oxide is early alpha. cutile-rs is further along, published on crates.io and already used outside NVIDIA in HuggingFace’s Grout inference engine and in mistral.rs .
sents.zh: 两个项目都处于早期阶段，均未达到生产可用状态。cuda-oxide 还处于早期 alpha 阶段。cutile-rs 的进展更远一些，已发布在 crates.io 上，并且已在 NVIDIA 之外得到使用，包括 HuggingFace 的 Grout 推理引擎和 mistral.rs。

sents.en: Coverage is incomplete and APIs will move.
sents.zh: 覆盖范围尚不完整，API 也会变动。

sents.en: Where you find rough edges, we want to hear about them.
sents.zh: 如果你发现了粗糙之处，我们希望听到你的反馈。

paragraphs.en: Cargo and crates set an expectation that getting started is easy. GPU programming has historically been the opposite, and closing that distance is part of the work. The SIMT track still needs a pinned nightly toolchain, which is exactly the kind of thing we would like to stop asking you for.
paragraphs.zh: Cargo 和 crates 让人们形成了一种预期：上手应该很简单。 GPU 编程在历史上一直与此相反，缩小这段距离是这项工作的一部分。 SIMT 路线仍然需要固定版本的 nightly 工具链，而这恰恰是我们希望不再要求你提供的那类东西。

sents.en: Cargo and crates set an expectation that getting started is easy.
sents.zh: Cargo 和 crates 让人们形成了一种预期：上手应该很简单。

sents.en: GPU programming has historically been the opposite, and closing that distance is part of the work.
sents.zh: GPU 编程在历史上一直与此相反，缩小这段距离是这项工作的一部分。

sents.en: The SIMT track still needs a pinned nightly toolchain, which is exactly the kind of thing we would like to stop asking you for.
sents.zh: SIMT 路线仍然需要固定版本的 nightly 工具链，而这恰恰是我们希望不再要求你提供的那类东西。

paragraphs.en: Rust on GPUs is not new. There is good work in this space that predates ours and continues alongside it. The ecosystem appendix in the cuda-oxide book maps where we sit relative to Rust-GPU, rust-cuda, CubeCL, and the rest, and we have been working with the rust-cuda maintainers as both projects mature.
paragraphs.zh: 在 GPU 上使用 Rust 并不是新鲜事。 这个领域已有一些优秀的工作，它们早于我们的项目，并且仍在与之并行发展。 cuda-oxide 书中的生态附录标明了我们相对于 Rust-GPU、rust-cuda、CubeCL 以及其他项目所处的位置，并且在两个项目逐步成熟的过程中，我们一直在与 rust-cuda 的维护者合作。

sents.en: Rust on GPUs is not new.
sents.zh: 在 GPU 上使用 Rust 并不是新鲜事。

sents.en: There is good work in this space that predates ours and continues alongside it.
sents.zh: 这个领域已有一些优秀的工作，它们早于我们的项目，并且仍在与之并行发展。

sents.en: The ecosystem appendix in the cuda-oxide book maps where we sit relative to Rust-GPU, rust-cuda, CubeCL, and the rest, and we have been working with the rust-cuda maintainers as both projects mature.
sents.zh: cuda-oxide 书中的生态附录标明了我们相对于 Rust-GPU、rust-cuda、CubeCL 以及其他项目所处的位置，并且在两个项目逐步成熟的过程中，我们一直在与 rust-cuda 的维护者合作。

paragraphs.en: What is new is the engineering we are putting behind it, and a clear sense of where it is going.
paragraphs.zh: 新的内容是我们为它所投入的工程实践，以及对其未来走向的清晰认识。

paragraphs.en: Tinker with what is here and come work on it with us. It is early, it is open, and what you build now will shape what comes next.
paragraphs.zh: 试试摆弄现有的一切，然后来和我们一起研究它。 现在还处于早期阶段，一切都是开放的，你此刻构建的东西将塑造未来的走向。

sents.en: Tinker with what is here and come work on it with us.
sents.zh: 试试摆弄现有的一切，然后来和我们一起研究它。

sents.en: It is early, it is open, and what you build now will shape what comes next.
sents.zh: 现在还处于早期阶段，一切都是开放的，你此刻构建的东西将塑造未来的走向。

paragraphs.en: NVIDIA is excited to be leaning in with the Rust community as we elevate native Rust GPU programming. Projects like rust-cuda, rust-gpu, and cudarc pioneered the marriage of GPUs and Rust, and the people behind them, including the team at VectorWare, continue to shape how we think about our own work as we build with the Rust community.
paragraphs.zh: 在提升原生 Rust GPU 编程能力的过程中，NVIDIA 很高兴能与 Rust 社区深入合作。 rust-cuda、rust-gpu 和 cudarc 等项目开创了 GPU 与 Rust 结合的先河，而包括 VectorWare 团队在内的这些项目背后的开发者，在我们与 Rust 社区共同构建的过程中，持续影响着我们对自身工作的思考方式。

sents.en: NVIDIA is excited to be leaning in with the Rust community as we elevate native Rust GPU programming.
sents.zh: 在提升原生 Rust GPU 编程能力的过程中，NVIDIA 很高兴能与 Rust 社区深入合作。

sents.en: Projects like rust-cuda, rust-gpu, and cudarc pioneered the marriage of GPUs and Rust, and the people behind them, including the team at VectorWare, continue to shape how we think about our own work as we build with the Rust community.
sents.zh: rust-cuda、rust-gpu 和 cudarc 等项目开创了 GPU 与 Rust 结合的先河，而包括 VectorWare 团队在内的这些项目背后的开发者，在我们与 Rust 社区共同构建的过程中，持续影响着我们对自身工作的思考方式。
